title: Cost-Sensitive Reversibility of Non-Deterministic Actions
abstract: arXiv:2611.30399v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Determining action reversibility requires checking whether the effects of an action can be undone. Recent work has extended reversibility to fully observable non-deterministic (FOND) planning. It distinguishes weak reversibility, where reversal may succeed, from strong-cyclic reversibility, where reversal is guaranteed under fairness. These notions are qualitative: they say whether reversal is possible, but not how costly it is.   We introduce cost-sensitive reversibility for non-deterministic actions. Given positive action costs, we define weak and strong reversal budgets, $k$-bounded reversibility, and a distinction between finite strong reversal and strong-cyclic reversal with unbounded worst-case cost. translated_title: 非确定性动作的代价敏感可逆性
translated_abstract: 判断动作是否可逆需要检查动作的效果能否被撤销。最近的研究已将可逆性概念扩展到完全可观察的非确定性（FOND）规划领域，区分了弱可逆性（撤销可能成功）与强循环可逆性（在公平性假设下撤销得到保证）。然而这些概念都是定性的：它们只能说明撤销是否可能，却无法说明撤销的代价有多大。我们为非确定性动作引入了代价敏感的可逆性。在给定正动作代价的前提下，我们定义了弱撤销预算与强撤销预算、k-有界可逆性，并区分了有限强撤销与最坏情况代价无界的强循环撤销。我们在一个可逆性格中将这些概念相互关联，证明了代价感知的策略合并结果，并展示了如何利用代价最优的经典规划与最坏情况分析来计算受限的弱撤销预算和强普适一致撤销预算。
tldr: 本文为非确定性动作提出了代价敏感的可逆性框架，通过定义弱/强撤销预算和k-有界可逆性等概念，将定性可逆性理论扩展为能够衡量撤销代价的定量体系，并建立了可逆性格和代价感知的策略合并方法。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a cost-sensitive reversibility framework for non-deterministic actions, extending qualitative reversibility into a quantitative theory by defining weak/strong reversal budgets and k-bounded reversibility, along with a reversibility lattice and cost-aware policy-merging results.
